title: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
author: Yuting Ning, Ruijia Cheng, Sushobhan Ghosh, Peitong Duan et al.

summary: An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps.
takeaways: We present iPrefBench, a benchmark for evaluating the infer and ask capabilities of personal mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user.
Evaluation of 7 frontier agents reveals a substantial gap between execution and personalization.
Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps.
